# Icon

## Icon

The one icon-aware component. A caller names a glyph semantically (`name: 'close'`); the theme carries the path data as the token `icon.close`, so the same `Icon` renders one set under one template and another set under the next, and a brand layer can override any single glyph.

### Decisions (roster flags `no_reference`, `superloom_decision`)

- **No upstream reference.** Icon sets are data, not components, in both reference systems; there is nothing to measure against. The gates for this row are structural, accessibility and cross-template consistency.
- **Size picks the glyph.** When the set draws its own glyph at the requested size (`sizes['16']`), that glyph is used with its own viewBox; otherwise the base glyph scales through its viewBox. Nothing is ever substituted from another set.
- **Decorative by default.** Without `accessibilityLabel` the icon is hidden from assistive technology; with one it is an image with that name. A component that pairs an icon with visible text passes no label.
- **Renderer.** `react-native-svg` on every platform, injected as `shared_libs.Svg`. On web the host bundler resolves its `.web.js` build; nothing is aliased by the library.

### Platform

Both. No fallback needed: `react-native-svg` draws on iOS, Android and web.

## Icon

Icon draws one semantic glyph from the theme through react-native-svg at a token size and color; it is the only icon-aware component and never substitutes a glyph; it has no upstream visual reference because icon sets are data in both reference systems; its anatomy is a Superloom decision.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `atom` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `none` |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | none |
| Flags | `no_reference` - no upstream visual reference; gates are structural, accessibility and cross-template; `superloom_decision` - anatomy or a value decided here, not measured from a reference |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | yes | Semantic icon name; a token `icon.<name>` in the theme. A name the theme lacks throws. |
| `size` | `number` | no | Rendered size in points. Default: the `size` metric (`size.icon_02`). The set's own glyph is used when it draws one at this size. |
| `color` | `string` | no | Color token leaf under `color.`. Default `icon_primary`. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `string` | no | Announced name. Absent means decorative: the icon is hidden from assistive technology. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the root. |
| `style` | `object` | no | Style forwarded to the root Svg (layout only; color and size are props). |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `size` | `size.icon_02` |

Color leaves accepted: `icon_primary`, `icon_secondary`, `icon_interactive`, `icon_disabled`, `icon_inverse`, `icon_on_color`, `icon_on_color_disabled`.

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"name":"close","accessibilityLabel":"Close"}` |
| decorative | `{"name":"checkmark"}` |
| small | `{"name":"chevron_down","size":16,"accessibilityLabel":"Expand"}` |
| large | `{"name":"search","size":32,"accessibilityLabel":"Search"}` |
| secondary | `{"name":"info","color":"icon_secondary","accessibilityLabel":"Information"}` |
| disabled | `{"name":"settings","color":"icon_disabled","accessibilityLabel":"Settings"}` |
